items.title: I was delighted to welcome my longtime friend, Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda, to the beautiful Blue Ridge Mountains for the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meetings. We discussed the strength of the U.S.-Japan alliance, shared macroeconomic and financial priorities, Japan’s monetary policy normalization, and the importance of sound policy formulation and communication to anchor inflation expectations and avoid excess exchange rate volatility.

items.title: Treasury promised to sever every economic lifeline Tehran has left and finally end the threat of the Iranian regime. We also warned that Iran’s enablers cannot continue to enjoy access to the U.S. dollar and the global financial system. Banque Misr UAE decided to find out the hard way, and today, we are taking the first step in holding it accountable for its continued, egregious support of the Iranian regime.
items.content:
Treasury promised to sever every economic lifeline Tehran has left and finally end the threat of the Iranian regime. We also warned that Iran’s enablers cannot continue to enjoy access to the U.S. dollar and the global financial system. Banque Misr UAE decided to find out the hard way, and today, we are taking the first step in holding it accountable for its continued, egregious support of the Iranian regime.Treasury Department (@USTreasury)Today, under Operation Economic Outcast,  @FinCENnews proposed a rule that would revoke Banque Misr UAE’s correspondent banking access to U.S. financial institutions. Additionally, Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctioned Bank Melli Dubai manager Reza Mohammad Taeedi, along with a Hong Kong-based front company that has helped launder funds for a sanctioned Iranian exchange house. Operation Economic Outcast is severing the remaining financial lifelines that sustain the Iranian regime.—  https://x.com/USTreasury/status/2093348276284051719 
— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent) Aug 28, 2026

items.title: I appreciate H.E. Shaikh Salman bin Khalifa Al Khalifa’s coordination on Operation Economic Outcast. Alongside @POTUS, we will continue to work closely to defend the integrity of the global financial system and cripple the threat of the Iranian regime.
items.content:
I appreciate H.E. Shaikh Salman bin Khalifa Al Khalifa’s coordination on Operation Economic Outcast. Alongside  @POTUS , we will continue to work closely to defend the integrity of the global financial system and cripple the threat of the Iranian regime.Treasury Department (@USTreasury). @SecScottBessent spoke today with Bahrain’s Minister of Finance and National Economy, H.E. Shaikh Salman bin Khalifa Al Khalifa, to discuss Operation Economic Outcast.

Secretary Bessent stressed that Iran must not be permitted to threaten international commerce or use the Strait of Hormuz as leverage against the global economy. He also emphasized the importance of sustained financial pressure on Iran’s remaining economic lifelines and underscored that the United States will hold the regime’s financial enablers accountable.

Secretary Bessent also welcomed Bahrain’s longstanding partnership and its continued commitment to safeguarding the integrity of the international financial system. The two officials agreed on the importance of continued coordination between the United States, Bahrain, GCC partners, and the broader international community to combat illicit finance and strengthen economic security.—  https://x.com/USTreasury/status/2092450535542526380 
— Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent (@SecScottBessent) Aug 26, 2026
